item.title: Binance loses $6.3 billion in record crypto heist blamed on North Korea
item.description: Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, suspended all deposits and withdrawals Friday after hackers stole roughly $6.3 billion in digital assets, in what security researchers called the largest cryptocurrency heist on record. The exchange put the "estimated total impact" of the attack…

item.title: Tech stocks rout deepens as AI capex fears erase over $1 trillion
item.description: US technology stocks suffered a severe sell-off on Friday as investors recoiled from mounting evidence that Big Tech’s massive spending on artificial intelligence is not yet translating into commensurate profits. The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite opened at its lowest level in more than two months…
